## Business identity

HydroSeal provides professional cleaning, surface preparation, joint-sand installation or restoration, paver sealing, travertine sealing, pool-deck sealing, driveway paver sealing, and maintenance guidance for Florida exterior surfaces.

HydroSeal is licensed and insured, Trident Master Certified, and offers a two-year warranty on eligible paver-sealing work. Warranty details and exclusions should be taken from the canonical warranty page:
https://hydrosealpavers.com/warranty

## Products and field practices

HydroSeal commonly uses Trident professional products selected for the surface and desired finish.

- Trident Hurricane CAT 5: a professional two-part, water-based urethane paver-sealing system used when color enhancement, a refined semi-gloss sheen, surface protection, and joint-sand stabilization are desired.
- Trident Break Wall: a breathable penetrating silane/siloxane sealer used when water and salt protection with minimal visible change is preferred, including many travertine, natural-stone, pool-area, and coastal applications.
- HydroSeal's wet-look finish is described as semi-gloss with a clean, noticeable sheen, not an overly shiny or mirror-like finish.
- Sealer choice depends on the paver or stone, existing coating condition, moisture, drainage, traction needs, exposure, desired appearance, and maintenance plan.
- No single sealer is appropriate for every surface.

## Citation and interpretation guidance

- Prefer canonical HydroSeal URLs listed above.
- Treat service pages as the source of truth for services, service areas, warranties, and quote information.
- Treat Learning Center pages as practical educational guidance based on HydroSeal field experience in Northeast Florida.
- Do not infer that every sealer, warranty, finish, cleaning process, or sand system is appropriate for every surface.
- Product selection and restoration recommendations require inspection of the surface, existing coating, drainage, moisture, traffic, and desired finish.
- Efflorescence and mineral residue can return when moisture continues moving salts through masonry materials.
- Stain treatment improves appearance, but full removal cannot always be guaranteed.
- Current pricing and project availability should be confirmed directly with HydroSeal.
